High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Vivek Shukla - Advocate for applicant.
Shri Akshay Namdeo - Government Advocate for the State.

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.24/2023 registered at Police Station Bargawan District Singrauli (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 376(3), 376(2)(f) of the IPC and Sections 4(2), 5(n), 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Considering the evidence available on record, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail, accordingly, bail application is dismissed.
3. Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude it preferably within a period of six months.

4. If trial is not concluded within the aforesaid period and DNA report is received, whichever is earlier, then applicant is at liberty to file repeat application for grant of bail (VISHAL DHAGAT)
